Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (Ministry of Railway) has released Exam City Details for the recruitment of Technician Grade-I & Grade-III on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 6565 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Technician Recruitment 2026 were accepted from June 30, 2026, to July 29, 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 06-09 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 06-09 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 27 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General : Rs. 400/-
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
